intro: Strange Smelling Powder is an enigmatic residue uncovered during investigations into suspicious sabotage around Loch Modan. Feared to be an unstable demolition agent, it prompts Chief Engineer Hinderweir to send an urgent courier north to seek out a demolition expert.

p: Discovered amid signs of sabotage threatening Loch Modan's infrastructure, this peculiar powder immediately raised alarm for Chief Engineer Hinderweir. Its pungent odor and fine consistency suggest an engineered demolition compound rather than standard mining blast powder. Unsure of the mixture's chemical nature or origin, Hinderweir refuses to tamper with it himself, knowing that even a slight spark could trigger disaster.
